_comment: Bajaj Allianz Private Car SATP (standalone-TP) model PO. USER 2026-06-26: Swift, Beat, Fiesta, I20 = Max 25% PO. SET to 0.25 (not cap=min(base)): the proper region SATP for these models is always >=25 (40-57.5), so set==cap, AND the engine sometimes pools a stray low model-row (e.g. Mumbai Beat base 0.05) that a min() cap would wrongly keep. SWIFT excludes 'Swift Dzire' (Dzire is a separate, lower tier). Matched by model token, any make. Extensible (e.g. Baleno/Dzire 2.5%).
